title: OSN-MDAD: MACHINE TRANSLATION DATASET FOR ARABIC MULTI-DIALECTAL CONVERSATIONS ON ONLINE SOCIAL MEDIA.

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation performance (using BLEU and ROUGE scores) on four distinct informal Arabic dialects (Gulf, Yemeni, Iraqi, and Levantine/Shami) to address the disparity in NLP resources and the poor performance of standard systems on regional dialects compared to Modern Standard Arabic.
